name: bootstrap-meta-missing
description: The host mounts the declaration-level shell (`ui://ggui/render`) and forwards a `ui/notifications/tool-result` whose `CallToolResult` carries neither the `ai.ggui/render` slice nor a render locator on its top-level `_meta`, so no source yields a slice: nothing inline on `globalThis.__GGUI_META__`, no read-plane door to take, and no slice on the forwarded result. After its bounded wait the view emits `postMessage({type:'ggui:bootstrap-failed', reason:'MISSING_META_GGUI_BOOTSTRAP', message})` to the parent, the spelling every reference emitter uses (SPEC §5.5.2). `BOOTSTRAP_META_MISSING` names the same failure and hosts classify both alike. No WS connection opens; live-channel envelopes are out of scope before the slice is read. (Rewritten under ggui#1304: the fixture used to override `ui/initialize` and look for `_meta.ggui.bootstrap`, a delivery path that no longer exists.)
